revenue_scope: US Aczone sales in the US block of Almirall's dermatology sales breakdown, EUR million. From the 2021 and 2022 decks the breakdown includes product consignment, royalties from authorized generics and up-fronts (footnote on the table).
why_separate: Almirall, not Allergan plc, owns Aczone in the U.S. (it closed the purchase of the Allergan U.S. medical dermatology portfolio, Aczone included, on 2018-09-21), so its line is a different issuer's figures in euros on a different basis from Allergan plc's global net revenues; the two issuers' lines also overlap in time (Almirall prints Aczone from 2019, Allergan plc until 2020Q1) and Almirall prints only whole millions, year-to-date or Q3/Q4 columns, so most quarters are derived. It therefore continues the product as a successor issuer's line and is not the gold series.
notes: Quarters 2020Q2-2023Q2 are read or derived from Almirall's results presentations (Q1, H1, 9M and FY decks). Direct quarter columns: 2020Q3 (9M 2020 deck, whole millions), 2020Q4 (FY 2020 deck), 2021Q1, 2022Q1, 2023Q1 (Q1 decks). Other quarters are year-to-date or full-year figures less the earlier quarters, with every input named in the row's quote. The 9M 2021 deck and the Q1 2020 deck could not be located, so nine months 2021 is read from the prior-year column of the 9M 2022 deck and first quarter 2020 (7.0) from the prior-year column of the Q1 2021 deck. Basis changes visible in the decks: the FY 2021 deck restates FY 2020 from 17.0 to 25.1 and the H1 2021 deck prints H1 2020 as 11.3 on its dermatology page and 15.5 on its product page, after consignment and authorized-generic royalties were added; the Q1 2022 deck prints Q1 2021 as 4.4 where the Q1 2021 deck printed 3.5. Rows use the deck of their own period. Year checks: 2021 quarters 3.5+7.2+6.5+4.3 = 21.5 as printed; 2022 quarters 2.2+1.2+3.8+3.0 = 10.2 as printed; 2020 quarters (first quarter 7.0 from the Q1 2021 deck, then 4.0, 2, 3.8) give 16.8 against 17.0 printed, the difference being the whole-million rounding. The line ends with 2023Q2: the FY 2023 deck and every later deck checked list no Aczone row in the US block and carry 'Others US' (FY 2023 deck 32.6, FY 2022 comparative 45.5, which equals the FY 2022 deck's Azelex, Cordran Tape, Aczone, Tazorac and Others US rows), and the 9M 2023 deck could not be located, so 2023Q3 is not claimed either way. Almirall's website blocks automated downloads, so decks are cited at blob.almirall.com, the host the site redirects to, except the H1 2021 deck, cited from the CNMV filing of the same document. AbbVie (the acquirer of Allergan plc) prints no Aczone line.

AbbVie (CIK 0001551152): all 75 Item 2.02 8-K exhibits and 10-Q/10-K filings from 2020-05-01 to 2026-10-05 searched case-insensitively for Aczone and dapsone: no match; so no AbbVie line.

Almirall results presentations downloaded and every page searched for lines beginning 'Aczone': Q1 2021, H1 2020, 9M 2020, FY 2020, H1 2021 (CNMV copy), FY 2021, Q1 2022, H1 2022, 9M 2022, FY 2022, Q1 2023, H1 2023 print an Aczone row; FY 2023, Q1 2024, H1 2025, 9M 2025, FY 2025, Q1 2026 and H1 2026 print none (the US block lists Seysara, Klisyri and Others US).
Not located: the Q1 2020, 9M 2021 and 9M 2023 decks (searched almirall.com, blob.almirall.com, cnmv.es); H1 2024, 9M 2024 and Q1 2025 decks were not downloaded.
Filters: PDF text per page, rows beginning 'Aczone' followed by a figure; narrative mentions of Aczone (generic competition) were read but carry no sales figure.
